name: clean-python-code
description: Personalized Python and PySpark formatting with hierarchical indentation, vertical chains, and aligned nested expressions.

cleanPythonCode.outerIndent.description: Spaces used for the first continuation line inside an assignment wrapped with parentheses.

cleanPythonCode.chainIndent.description: Additional spaces used before chained method calls such as .filter() and .select().

cleanPythonCode.argumentIndent.description: Additional spaces used for arguments inside expanded calls, lists and dictionaries.

cleanPythonCode.maxInlineLength.description: Expressions longer than this are preferentially expanded. Chained assignments are expanded even when shorter.

cleanPythonCode.leadingComma.description: Place commas at the beginning of subsequent lines in expanded argument lists and collections, matching the reference style.

cleanPythonCode.expandBooleanOperators.description: Expand complex boolean expressions using &, |, and Python's and/or operators onto separate lines when appropriate.
